tagline.zh: 三站、一尊銅人、一位會反問的標準化病人
tagline.en: Three stations, one bronze figure, and a standardised patient who asks the questions back

desc.zh: 今天的考生。先找標誌，再用病人的手量，最後按壓確認。別忘了吃早餐。
desc.en: Today's candidate. Find the landmark, measure with the patient's hand, confirm by pressing. And eat breakfast.

desc.zh: 帶練習、看流程、給回饋。評的是方法，不是運氣。
desc.en: Run the practice, watch the method, give feedback. You grade the process, not the luck.

about.zh: 口頭禪：骨度是尺，手指是病人的。考試前會偷偷確認每個學生有沒有吃早餐。
about.en: Catchphrase: bone proportions are the ruler, the fingers belong to the patient. Quietly checks before every exam whether the students have eaten.

about.zh: 評分表永遠寫得很具體。他自己當年考定位時，也是用錯手指。
about.en: His feedback sheets are always specific. When he sat the exam himself, he also measured with the wrong hand.

role.zh: 同學，背得很熟，摸不太到
role.en: Classmate; knows the text, struggles on skin

about.zh: 定位文字倒背如流，一摸真人就慌。今天太緊張沒吃早餐。
about.en: Can recite every location, panics on a real body. Too nervous to eat breakfast today.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。教了三十年書，退休後自願當標準化病人。你考他，他也考你。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Taught for thirty years, now volunteers as a standardised patient. You examine him; he examines you.

about.zh: 訊息永遠準時，成績永遠晚一點。
about.en: Messages always on time, results always a little late.

about.zh: 病人要灸足三里，她想確認位置。問對人了。
about.en: A patient is due moxa at Zusanli and she wants to be sure of the spot. She asked the right people.

plain.zh: 把身體各段骨頭的長度定為固定的「寸」數，不論高矮胖瘦都按比例折算，是取穴最基本的尺。
plain.en: Each segment of the body is assigned a fixed number of cun regardless of the person's size, so distances scale with the individual; the basic ruler for locating points.

plain.zh: 用病人自己的手指當單位：中指中節為一寸、拇指寬為一寸、四指併攏為三寸。
plain.en: Units taken from the patient's own hand: the middle segment of the middle finger as one cun, the thumb width as one cun, four fingers together as three cun.

plain.zh: 食中無名小指併攏，以中指中節橫紋為準的寬度為三寸；一定用病人的手。
plain.en: The width of the patient's four fingers held together, measured at the middle crease of the middle finger, counts as three cun; always the patient's hand.

plain.zh: 骨頭突起、肌腱、皮膚橫紋、髮際等摸得到看得到的參考點，取穴先找它們。
plain.en: Bony prominences, tendons, skin creases and hairlines you can see or feel; point location starts from them.

plain.zh: 屈膝時髕骨下方外側的凹陷，又叫外膝眼；足三里從這裡往下量。
plain.en: The hollow below and lateral to the kneecap when the knee is bent, the outer “knee eye”; Zusanli is measured down from it.

plain.zh: 小腿前面摸得到的那條骨脊；足三里在它外側一橫指。
plain.en: The sharp ridge you can feel down the front of the shin; Zusanli lies one finger-breadth lateral to it.

plain.zh: 每條經脈上代表該臟腑原氣的穴，例如合谷、太溪；診治該臟腑常用。
plain.en: The point on each meridian said to hold its organ's source qi, such as Hegu and Taixi; commonly used to assess and treat that organ.

plain.zh: 五輸穴的最後一個，位在肘膝附近，中醫認為經氣在此匯入如水入海，例如足三里、曲池。
plain.en: The last of the five transport points, near the elbow or knee, where in TCM the channel qi pours in like a river into the sea; Zusanli and Quchi for example.

plain.zh: 六腑在下肢各有一個合穴，足三里是胃的下合穴，所以「肚腹三里留」。
plain.en: Each of the six fu organs has a he-sea point on the leg; Zusanli is the stomach's, hence “for the belly, keep to Sanli”.

plain.zh: 兩條以上經脈相交的穴；三陰交是脾肝腎三經的交會，一穴管三經。
plain.en: A point where two or more meridians meet; Sanyinjiao is where the Spleen, Liver and Kidney channels cross, one point for three meridians.

plain.zh: 沒有固定位置、按下去「啊，是這裡」的壓痛點；治痛有用，定位考不考它。
plain.en: A tender spot with no fixed location, the “ah, yes, there” point; useful for pain, but never on a location exam.

plain.zh: 針身與皮膚垂直進針，用在肌肉豐厚的部位，例如足三里。
plain.en: The needle enters at right angles to the skin, used where muscle is thick, as at Zusanli.

plain.zh: 受過訓練、依劇本扮演病人並給回饋的人；考試裡最誠實的一份評分。
plain.en: A trained person who plays a patient to a script and gives feedback; the most honest mark in any exam.

plain.zh: 針刺時頭暈、眼前發黑、冒冷汗甚至昏倒；空腹、緊張、坐姿、疲勞都是危險因子。
plain.en: Dizziness, blackening vision, cold sweat or collapse during needling; an empty stomach, anxiety, sitting up and fatigue all raise the risk.

plain.zh: 淡紅舌、薄白苔、不胖不瘦、活動自如。知道正常，才看得出異常。
plain.en: A pale-red body, thin white coat, neither swollen nor thin, moving freely. You can only spot the abnormal once you know the normal.

text.zh: 宋代王惟一鑄造的教學與考試用人形，穴孔灌水封蠟，針中則水出。今天的銅人是樹脂的，但考法一樣：先找標誌，再找穴。
text.en: The teaching and examination figure cast by Wang Weiyi in the Song dynasty: point holes filled with water and sealed with wax, a correct needle let the water out. Today's figure is resin, but the test is the same: landmark first, then point.

text.zh: 十四經循行與常用穴一覽。考前複習用它，考試時不能看它。
text.en: The fourteen meridians and common points at a glance. For revision before the exam, and out of sight during it.

text.zh: 今天借來當評分桌。脈枕讓手腕放鬆，方便量前臂的骨度：肘橫紋到腕橫紋算十二寸。
text.en: Borrowed as the marking desk today. The pulse cushion relaxes the wrist, which also makes the forearm's bone proportion easy to measure: elbow crease to wrist crease counts as twelve cun.

text.zh: 邱醫師發的卡：標誌→量→按→核對左右。四個字一個步驟，少一個都扣分。
text.en: Dr Chiu's card: landmark, measure, press, check both sides. One word per step; miss one and you lose the mark.

name.en: Wang Weiyi and the bronze figure

text.zh: 北宋醫官，奉詔整理腧穴，撰《銅人腧穴針灸圖經》並鑄銅人兩具，把穴位的定位變成可以考試、可以複製的標準。
text.en: A Northern Song court physician commissioned to standardise the points; he wrote the Illustrated Manual of the Bronze Figure and cast two figures, turning point location into something that could be examined and reproduced.

name.en: Four ways to locate a point

text.zh: 骨度分寸：以骨節為尺按比例折算。同身寸：病人的手指當單位。體表標誌：骨突、肌腱、橫紋、髮際。簡便取穴：兩手虎口交叉食指尖到列缺、垂手中指尖到風市。四法互相核對，最後按壓確認酸脹感。
text.en: Bone-proportional cun: bony segments as a scaled ruler. Body cun: the patient's fingers as units. Surface landmarks: prominences, tendons, creases, hairlines. Convenience methods: crossed thumb-webs put the index tip on Lieque; the hanging middle finger finds Fengshi. The four cross-check one another, and pressing for an ache confirms the spot.

text.zh: 原穴反映臟腑原氣，合穴治腑病，下合穴是六腑在下肢的門戶，交會穴一穴通數經，絡穴溝通表裡。中醫認為記住穴位的「身分」，就記住了它常用的理由。定位考後面接著的，是主治考。
text.en: Yuan-source points reflect an organ's source qi, he-sea points treat the fu organs, lower he-sea points are the fu organs' gateways on the legs, crossing points reach several meridians at once, luo-connecting points link paired channels. In TCM, knowing a point's “identity” is knowing why it is used. After the location exam comes the indications exam.

name.en: Safety when students needle each other

text.zh: 空腹不練、緊張不練、一律臥位、只練安全穴位、老師在場、針盤清點。暈針時：出針、平臥抬腿、保暖、監測、通知老師。考試考的不只是穴位。
text.en: Never on an empty stomach, never when anxious, always lying down, only safe points, a teacher present, the tray counted. In a needle faint: needles out, lie flat with legs raised, warm, monitor, tell the teacher. The exam tests more than points.

lines.zh: 中醫診間今天借給針灸學考試。白板上寫著三站：銅人、真人、進針示範。
lines.en: The TCM consulting room is lent to the acupuncture exam today. The board lists three stations: bronze figure, live model, insertion demonstration.

lines.zh: 考定位之前，先問你最常用的三個穴：合谷、足三里、三陰交。定位三寶。
lines.en: Before the exam, the three points you will use most: Hegu, Zusanli, Sanyinjiao. The three essentials.

lines.zh: 在掛圖上指給我看。順便說它們是什麼穴。
lines.en: Show me on the chart. And tell me what kind of point each is.

q.zh: 指出合谷、足三里、三陰交
q.en: Point to Hegu, Zusanli and Sanyinjiao

post.zh: 合谷是原穴，足三里是合穴也是胃的下合穴，三陰交是三陰經的交會穴。
post.en: Hegu is a yuan-source point, Zusanli a he-sea point and the stomach's lower he-sea point, Sanyinjiao the crossing point of the three leg yin meridians.
That will be asked. Have you eaten breakfast?

guide.en: Practise body cun with the TA

lines.zh: 骨度分寸是尺，但尺要用病人的。中指同身寸、拇指同身寸、橫指同身寸，來一遍。
lines.en: Bone-proportional cun is the ruler, but the ruler is the patient's. Middle-finger cun, thumb cun, finger-breadth cun: once through.

post.zh: 四橫指是三寸，用病人的手。我當年就是用自己的手被扣分。
post.en: Four finger-breadths make three cun, with the patient's hand. I lost marks for using my own, back in the day.

note.zh: 第一站：先找標誌，再找穴

guide.en: Station 1: points on the bronze figure

lines.zh: 銅人上沒有肉，只有標誌。先找體表標誌，再找穴。百會、風池、曲池。
lines.en: The bronze figure has no flesh, only landmarks. Surface landmark first, then point. Baihui, Fengchi, Quchi.

q.zh: 在銅人上指出百會、風池、曲池
q.en: On the bronze figure, point to Baihui, Fengchi and Quchi

post.zh: 百會：兩耳尖連線的中點。風池：枕骨下兩條筋之間的凹陷。曲池：屈肘，肘橫紋外端。
post.en: Baihui: the midpoint of the line joining the ear apices. Fengchi: the hollow below the occiput between the two muscle cords. Quchi: elbow bent, the outer end of the crease.

lines.zh: 我定位文字都背得出來，一摸真人就找不到。怎麼辦？
lines.en: I can recite every location, and the moment I touch a real person I can't find anything. What do I do?

lines.zh: 你回答她。
lines.en: You answer her.

q.zh: 小雨問：在真人身上找穴，最可靠的方法？
q.en: Hsiao-Yu asks: what is the most reliable way to find a point on a real person?

options.zh: 先找體表標誌，再用病人的同身寸量
options.en: Landmark first, then the patient's body cun

why.zh: 標誌不會騙人，尺用病人的；最後按壓確認酸脹。
why.en: Landmarks do not lie and the ruler is the patient's; a press for the ache confirms it.

options.en: Memorise the chart and copy it

why.zh: 掛圖是平均人，真人沒有一個是平均的。
why.en: The chart is an average person; no real person is average.

options.en: Press until it hurts most; that's it

why.zh: 那是阿是穴，治痛有用，定位考不考它。
why.en: That is an ashi point, useful for pain, never on a location exam.

note.en: Station 2: measured with Uncle Chen's hand

guide.en: Station 2: location on a live model

lines.zh: 我教了三十年書，退休來當標準化病人。你們考我，我也考你們。
lines.en: I taught for thirty years; now I'm a standardised patient. You examine me, I examine you.

lines.zh: 陳伯好。
lines.en: Good morning, Uncle Chen.

lines.zh: 足三里在哪？先講，再摸。
lines.en: Where is Zusanli? Say it first, then find it.

q.zh: 足三里要從犢鼻往下量「四橫指」。你用誰的手指？
q.en: Zusanli is four finger-breadths below Dubi. Whose fingers do you use?

options.zh: 用陳伯的手指，從犢鼻往下量
options.en: Uncle Chen's fingers, measured down from Dubi

why.zh: 同身寸是「同身」：病人的身、病人的手。
why.en: Body cun means the patient's body and the patient's hand.

options.zh: 用自己的手指量比較快

why.zh: 你的手比陳伯小。快一秒，差一個穴。
why.en: Your hand is smaller than Uncle Chen's. One second faster, one point out.

options.zh: 不用量，膝下外側按到酸就是
options.en: No measuring; press below the knee until it aches

why.zh: 酸的地方可能是阿是穴，不一定是足三里。
why.en: The sore spot may be an ashi point, not necessarily Zusanli.

post.zh: 我很高，你的手小。這題我每年都出。
post.en: I'm tall and your hand is small. I set this question every year.

guide.zh: 指出足三里、三陰交、太溪
guide.en: Point to Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Taixi

lines.zh: 犢鼻、脛骨前嵴、內踝尖、跟腱。標誌先摸出來，再量。
lines.en: Dubi, tibial crest, medial malleolus tip, Achilles tendon. Feel the landmarks first, then measure.

q.zh: 在陳伯腿上指出足三里、三陰交、太溪
q.en: On Uncle Chen's leg, point to Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Taixi

post.zh: 足三里：犢鼻下四橫指、脛骨前嵴外一橫指。三陰交：內踝尖上四橫指、脛骨內側緣後方。太溪：內踝尖與跟腱之間。
post.en: Zusanli: four finger-breadths below Dubi, one lateral to the tibial crest. Sanyinjiao: four finger-breadths above the medial malleolus tip, behind the tibial border. Taixi: between the malleolus tip and the Achilles tendon.
She's on it; it aches properly. Pass.

lines.zh: 我舌頭也可以考。來，看看正不正常。
lines.en: My tongue can be examined too. Come on, is it normal?

lines.zh: 他比題庫會出題。看吧。
lines.en: He sets better questions than the question bank. Go on.

q.zh: 陳伯的舌：淡紅、苔薄白、不胖不瘦、伸舌居中。這是？
q.en: Uncle Chen's tongue: pale red, thin white coat, neither swollen nor thin, protrudes straight. This is?

why.zh: 淡紅舌薄白苔就是正常。知道正常，才看得出異常。
why.en: A pale-red body with a thin white coat is normal. Knowing the normal is how you spot the abnormal.

why.zh: 氣虛舌淡胖、邊有齒痕。他的不胖。
why.en: A qi-deficient tongue is pale, swollen and tooth-marked. His is not swollen.

why.zh: 熱證舌紅苔黃。他的苔是白的。
why.en: A heat tongue is red with a yellow coat. His coat is white.

why.zh: 瘀血舌紫暗或有瘀點。他的是淡紅。
why.en: A stasis tongue is purple or spotted. His is pale red.

post.zh: 這是今天最好的評語：正常。
post.en: Best remark of the day: normal.

guide.en: Write the feedback with the TA

lines.zh: 助教看什麼：有沒有先找標誌、有沒有用病人的手、有沒有按壓確認、有沒有核對左右。
lines.en: What the TA watches: landmark first, patient's hand, confirmation by pressing, both sides checked.

lines.zh: 她標誌找得好，第三步忘了按。
lines.en: Her landmarks were good; she forgot step three, the press.

lines.zh: 寫下來。回饋要具體，不要寫「加油」。
lines.en: Write it down. Feedback is specific; never just “keep trying”.

note.zh: 電話教定位：講標誌，不講感覺
note.en: Locating by phone: landmarks, not feelings

sub.zh: 病人要灸足三里，躺著，我怎麼找？
sub.en: Patient due moxa at Zusanli, lying down. How do I find it?

lines.zh: 醫囑要灸足三里，病人躺著。我怎麼找才準？
lines.en: The order is moxa at Zusanli and the patient is lying down. How do I find it accurately?

lines.zh: 請他屈膝，我一步一步說。
lines.en: Have him bend the knee; I'll take you through it step by step.

q.zh: 電話裡教護理師找足三里的步驟
q.en: The steps for finding Zusanli, over the phone

steps.zh: 屈膝，找到髕骨下外側的凹陷犢鼻
steps.en: Bend the knee, find Dubi below the kneecap

steps.zh: 用病人的四橫指從犢鼻往下量
steps.en: Patient's four fingers measured down from Dubi
One finger-breadth lateral to the tibial crest
Mark it, check both legs match

post.en: Done as you said; he says it aches. Thanks.

post.zh: 電話裡教定位，講標誌不講感覺。你做對了。
post.en: Teaching location by phone, you give landmarks, not feelings. You did it right.

sub.zh: 第三站改到治療床，成績下午公布
sub.en: Station 3 moved to the couch; results this afternoon

lines.zh: 第三站進針示範改在治療床，模型已送到。成績下午公布。
lines.en: Station 3, insertion demonstration, moves to the couch; the model has arrived. Results this afternoon.

lines.zh: 我不餓。真的。快考完了。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. Really. It's nearly over.

lines.zh: 記住她這句話。
lines.en: Remember what she just said.

note.zh: 第三站：小雨暈針，處理得當

guide.zh: 第三站：模型上示範直刺
guide.en: Station 3: perpendicular insertion on the model

lines.zh: 在模型上示範足三里直刺，依穴位標準深度。針身與皮膚垂直。
lines.en: On the model, demonstrate perpendicular insertion at Zusanli to the point's standard depth. Needle at right angles to the skin.

post.zh: 足三里下面是脛骨前肌，安全。但安全不等於越深越好。
post.en: Beneath Zusanli lies tibialis anterior: safe. But safe does not mean the deeper the better.

guide.en: Classmates practise Hegu on each other

lines.zh: 換我當模特兒。坐著就好，我不躺。
lines.en: My turn as the model. Sitting is fine; I don't need to lie down.

lines.zh: 一律臥位。規定。
lines.en: Lying down, everyone. House rule.

lines.zh: 針進合谷沒多久，小雨說眼前發黑，額頭全是汗。
lines.en: Shortly after the needle enters Hegu, Hsiao-Yu says everything has gone dark, her forehead slick with sweat.

options.zh: 立刻出針，平臥抬腿，保暖，監測並通知老師
options.en: Needle out at once, flat with legs raised, warm, monitor, tell the teacher

why.zh: 暈針的處理順序永遠是出針、平臥、保暖、監測。她已經躺著，所以沒有跌倒。
why.en: The order in a needle faint is always needle out, lie flat, warm, monitor. She was already lying down, so there was no fall.

options.en: Help her sit up and rest

why.zh: 坐起來腦部血流更少，會真的昏倒。
why.en: Sitting up starves the brain further; she would really pass out.

why.zh: 針還在，刺激還在。沒有「快好了」。
why.en: While the needle stays, the stimulus stays. There is no “nearly done”.

post.zh: 暈針。空腹、緊張、第一次。考試考的，不只是穴位。
post.en: A needle faint. Empty stomach, nerves, first time. The exam tests more than points.

lines.zh: 剛才用我的手量的那一位，足三里按得最準。我有在看。
lines.en: The one who measured with my hand found Zusanli most accurately. I was watching.

lines.zh: 你剛才用自己的手量陳伯。他的腿比你長一截，差了快一個穴。
lines.en: You measured Uncle Chen with your own hand. His leg is a good deal longer than yours; you were nearly a whole point out.

lines.zh: 定位考通過了。我更在意兩件事：你用了病人的手，小雨倒下去時你第一個動作是出針。
lines.en: You passed the location exam. Two things matter more to me: you used the patient's hand, and when Hsiao-Yu went down your first move was the needle out.

lines.zh: 第二站我忘了按壓確認。
lines.en: At station two I forgot to press and confirm.

lines.zh: 對，陳伯記得。下次。這張卡收好。
lines.en: Yes, Uncle Chen remembers. Next time. Keep this card.

lines.zh: 下個月我還來。我會準備新題目。
lines.en: I'll be back next month. With new questions.

lines.zh: 陳伯，您的舌頭很正常。
lines.en: Uncle Chen, your tongue is very normal.

lines.zh: 這句我要寫進回饋表。
lines.en: That line is going on my feedback form.

sub.zh: 我吃飽了。明天要不要一起去看陳伯？
sub.en: I've eaten. Shall we visit Uncle Chen tomorrow?

lines.zh: 我吃飽了。明天要不要一起去看陳伯？他說要教我們他以前怎麼教書。
lines.en: I've eaten. Want to visit Uncle Chen tomorrow? He says he'll teach us how he used to teach.

lines.zh: 好。帶早餐。
lines.en: Yes. Bring breakfast.

lines.zh: 邱醫師的訊息也進來了：「骨度是尺，手指是病人的。晚安。」
lines.en: Dr Chiu's message arrives too: “Bone proportions are the ruler, the fingers belong to the patient. Good night.”

sub.en: Landmark, measure, press, check both sides
